howWorks.title: How does it work?
howWorks.description: Buy and sell tokens without relying on an exchange! Neon provides an effortless and secure way to buy and sell digital assets using fiat money.

all.observation: After the transfer has been completed, your new tokens will take a few moments to arrive.

buyTokens.text: <1>This process uses an embedded widget.</1> When buying tokens, some personal data might be requested for KYC purposes. <1>Larger sales require a greater amount of KYC data.</1>
buyTokens.kyc: <1>Once the KYC process is complete:</1> You will need to provide a destination address for your tokens. From the 'Wallets & Accounts' panel, copy the destination address of your desired Neon account.
buyTokens.alert: Ensure that the account you select is compatible with the network of your purchased token!

sellTokens.text: <1>This process uses an embedded widget.</1> When selling tokens, some personal data might be requested for KYC purposes. <2>Larger sales require a greater amount of KYC data.</2>
sellTokens.kyc: <1>Once the KYC process is complete:</1> You will need to send your tokens to the deposit address using the ‘Make a Deposit’ button.  Please ensure that you transfer the correct amount of tokens to the deposit address! You can also copy a destination address of your desired Neon account, from the 'Wallets & Accounts' panel.

sideBar.title: How does it work?
steps: Neon will create a new Neo N3 account using your existing private key and add it to your wallet
We will process the transaction once you have confirmed the details
Migrations usually take less than 30 seconds to finish. You can check the status in the Account 'Activity' tab
sideBar.fee: Migration fees are around 1% (rounded up and include a small amount of GAS to support transactions on the new network). Minimum of 0.1 GAS or 2 NEO.
sideBar.alert: This migration tool will only move your NEO and GAS. It will not move your other NEP-5 tokens. You will need to contact these projects to learn how to migrate their tokens

explanation.title: How does it work?
explanation.description1: Easily bridge your crypto assets between networks, without ever leaving your wallet.
explanation.description2: Blockchains are independent of each other, and can’t interact with each other - That's where bridges come in. It’s similar in principle to exchanging money while traveling to different countries, a bridge allows you to transfer assets across various blockchains.
explanation.description3: Directly and immediately bridging tokens in NEON is convenient and allows you to save time and pay lower fees.
explanation.alert: COZ are not maintainers of this bridging process - Neo Global Development is the maintainer.
